lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 2 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: US-R2-001 fixes the recovery-runbook.md section (v.1) that contradicted the US-R1-002 env-var change. Key changes: (1) removed the [notify] resend_api_key = 're_xxxx' TOML example (the key is never persisted to project.toml); (2) replaced with 'export RESEND_API_KEY=...' shell env pattern; (3) removed '--resend-api-key re_xxxx' from the cam init example (flag exists but does not persist); (4) updated the warning block to include the full hint text from setup.ts:247 referencing RESEND_API_KEY env var. The runbook now correctly reflects that only resend_recipient is stored in [notify] and RESEND_API_KEY must be in the shell environment.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure documentation fix in docs/recovery-runbook.md. No external library code was touched.
